gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.flouris:
Summer blooms in splendor,
swaying like waves.
The traveler opens their arms;
scent fills their sleeves.

At witching dusk,
fireflies rise.
Insect song floods all.
The traveler, a little tired,
sinks into earthbound stars.

Shreds of sunlight fall.
The traveler lifts a hand:
a gaze flashes between fingers.
Grass swells; flowers blaze.

“How quiet…”
Amid the ceaseless rustle,
the traveler speaks.
He quickens his pace.

tooltip.the_long_travail.summary.mistlet: Right-click a non-player creature while holding §6Mistletoe§r to consume it and apply the beneficial §6Mistletoe§r effect. Repeated uses increase its level and extend its duration.
The effect strengthens the target while active. When it expires naturally, it deals backlash damage and may yield additional loot.
Higher effect levels increase the bonuses, backlash damage, and chance of additional loot.
tooltip.the_long_travail.summary.everlas: Accelerates the natural growth of nearby plants while worn.
§dWhile Flourishing holds Malice, §rthe wearer may gain §6Resistance§r when dealing damage, and gains increased movement speed and reduced damage taken in certain biomes.
§dOnce Flourishing has borne Witness, §rthe wearer may deal §6additional damage§r equal to the original hit (which can trigger repeatedly), and deals increased damage in certain biomes.
§aSneak and right-click§r while holding this item to enable or disable growth acceleration.
tooltip.the_long_travail.growth_items.mi: While holding Mistletoe, the user can right-click a non-player creature to apply the Mistletoe effect for %s seconds.
For each level of Mistletoe, the target gains %1$s%% movement speed, deals %2$s%% more damage, and takes %3$s%% less damage.
Using Mistletoe again on an affected target increases its level by 1 and extends its remaining duration by %1$s seconds, up to level %2$s.
At the maximum level, further uses still extend the duration.
When Mistletoe expires naturally, each level deals sourceless magic damage equal to %s%% of the target’s maximum health.

In addition, when the effect ends, a single “Parasitic Separation” roll is made. On success, the former effect holder drops one of each identifiable item in its loot table. Each level of Mistletoe provides a %1$s%% success chance, with this drop guaranteed at level %2$s.
Removing the effect early or the target dying before Mistletoe expires triggers neither backlash nor additional loot.
Each successful use consumes 1 Mistletoe; if the target cannot receive the effect, none is consumed.
tooltip.the_long_travail.growth_items.ev: While worn, accelerates the natural growth of plants within a horizontal radius of %1$s blocks and up to %2$s blocks above or below the wearer.
Sneak and right-click while holding this item to enable or disable growth acceleration.

Growth acceleration applies to crops, saplings, pumpkin and melon stems, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berry bushes, sugar cane, cacti, bamboo, and the growing tips of kelp, weeping vines, twisting vines, and similar plants.

Growth acceleration provides each plant with at most 1 additional natural growth opportunity every %s seconds, while still requiring its own growth conditions to be met. Overlapping growth areas do not stack.
§dWhile wearing The Long Travail, if Flourishing still holds Malice:
When the wearer deals damage, there is a %1$s%% chance to gain Resistance %2$s for %3$s seconds.
In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forest, Cherry Grove, or Meadow biomes, the wearer gains %1$s%% movement speed and takes %2$s%% less damage.
When the wearer deals damage, there is a %s%% chance to deal additional damage equal to the actual damage of that hit. Each successful additional hit has the same chance to trigger another.
In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forest, Cherry Grove, or Meadow biomes, the wearer deals %s%% more damage.
Pending additional damage ends for any of the following reasons:
1. The wearer removes The Long Travail;
3. The wearer no longer has the Witness of Flourishing;
4. The wearer or target dies, leaves the loaded area, or leaves the dimension where the original hit occurred.

Growth acceleration provides each plant with at most 1 additional natural growth opportunity every second, while still requiring its own growth conditions to be met. Overlapping growth areas do not stack.
tooltip.the_long_travail.growth_items.mi: In addition, when the effect ends, a single “Parasitic Separation” roll is made. On success, the former effect holder drops one of each identifiable item in its loot table. Each level of Mistletoe provides a %1$s%% success chance.

tooltip.the_long_travail.summary.immorta: Craft shapelessly with §aa damageable item§r to §6fully repair it§r and grant “§6Evergreen§r”.
tooltip.the_long_travail.immortal_bud.de: Craft an Immortal Bud shapelessly with a damageable item to fully repair it and grant the “Evergreen” mark.
Each craft consumes one Immortal Bud. Items already bearing the mark cannot receive it again.
Crafting only adds the mark; the item’s original name, enchantments, and other data are preserved.
Items bearing “Evergreen” are protected against durability loss, including breakage caused by an excessive single durability cost.
The Immortal Bud itself and protected items resist fire, lava, and explosions when dropped, and do not naturally despawn.
“Evergreen” does not protect against consumption through crafting, placement, or use. Protected items that fall into the void cannot be recovered.
